name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana
summary: ₹11,000 cash benefit to pregnant women and nursing mothers
hindi_summary: Garbhvati mahilaon ko 11,000 rupaye ki madad teen kiston mein
benefits: ₹11,000 in installments for first child, nutrition support, institutional delivery incentive
eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers for first living child, age 19+
